title: Research AI Agents — Technology, Trends, and Market Landscape
description: Research the current state of AI agents: key technologies (LLMs, RAG, agentic frameworks, multi-agent systems), major players (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft, Meta, etc.), market landscape (market size, growth forecasts, industry adoption), applications (customer service, coding agents, autonomous driving, robotics, enterprise automation), and recent trends. Produce a structured Markdown report with sections: Technology Overview, Key Players & Products, Market Landscape, Applications, Trends & Outlook. Save the report as research_agents.md in the workspace.

title: Research AI Stocks — Top Publicly Traded AI Companies
description: Research top publicly traded AI-related stocks: companies like NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Alphabet/Google (GOOGL), Amazon (AMZN), Meta (META), Palantir (PLTR), C3.ai (AI), CrowdStrike (CRWD), etc. For each, report: ticker, business segment related to AI, recent financial highlights (revenue, growth rate, P/E ratio if known), AI-specific revenue exposure, analyst outlook, and key risks. Produce a structured Markdown report with sections: Overview, Company Profiles (with ticker and metrics), Competitive Landscape, Risks, Outlook. Save the report as research_stocks.md in the workspace.

title: Check Python Environment & Install python-pptx
description: Check if Python 3 is available on this Windows system by running 'python --version' in cmd.exe. If Python is available, install/verify the python-pptx library using 'pip install python-pptx'. If Python is not available, install it via winget or the Microsoft Store Python package, then install python-pptx. Create a test script test_pptx.py that imports pptx and prints the version, then run it to confirm. Report back the Python path, version, and python-pptx version.

title: Synthesize Research into Structured Presentation Content
description: Read the research_agents.md and research_stocks.md files produced by the research tasks. Synthesize them into a structured, slide-by-slide Markdown document (presentation_content.md) suitable for a 12-15 slide PowerPoint presentation. Each slide entry must include: slide number, title, bullet-point content (4-6 points per slide), and notes on visual layout (charts, images, tables). Suggested slide deck structure: Title Slide, Executive Summary, AI Agents Overview, Key AI Agent Players, AI Agent Applications & Use Cases, Agent Market Landscape, AI Stocks Overview, Top AI Stock Profiles (2-3 slides), AI Stock Performance Comparison, Risks & Considerations, Investment Outlook, Conclusion. Format the output as presentation_content.md.

title: Generate PowerPoint .pptx File from Slide Content
description: Write and execute a Python script (generate_pptx.py) that uses python-pptx to generate a professional PowerPoint presentation. Read the slide content from presentation_content.md. Use these design guidelines: a professional color scheme (dark blue title slides, white content backgrounds), title slide with large centered title and subtitle, content slides with title bar and bullet-point text boxes, consistent fonts (Calibri or similar), appropriate font sizes (title 36pt, slide title 28pt, body 18pt), slide dimensions 16:9. The script must also: make slides self-contained (no external image references unless available locally), use Python pptx.enum.text for formatting, and save the file as AI_Agents_and_AI_Stocks.pptx in the workspace. After generation, verify the file exists and report its size. If the script fails, debug and retry.
